title: Force of Improbability
paragraphs: One of the most improbable discoveries was, of course, the practical application of the Force of Improbability. Not just the theory, misunderstood by gamblers since the dawn of time, but actual uses for it.

Loosely unrelated to the Uncertainty Principle, improbability when properly harnessed has many startling effects. Needless to say, it has its dangers, as evidenced by the well-documented series of kitchen explosions in Bloomington Illinois, but since the publication of Gottlieb’s “Improbability: Certain ways to Use It in The Home and Workshop” home experimentation has really taken off.
The trick is, of course, to just cast one’s fate to the wind and simply ride on it.
